audit.whatIsWrong: Two systematic errors. First, Devour is described as something he casts on himself or a minion — 'he can W-eat himself to safety or eat a minion to reposition', 'W-devour self or minions to disengage and roam', 'W self-devour'. Devour targets a champion: an enemy takes magic damage, an ally gets shielded. Second, the grey health is credited to his passive in four places. The passive is An Acquired Taste, which is bonus damage and the Devour stack counter; the grey health and the shield are Thick Skin (E). Tongue Lash is also called a stun outright, when it only stuns a champion who already carries three An Acquired Taste stacks.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally'; 'Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes… Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield'; 'If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' A Darius told to wait out a self-devour is waiting for something that will not happen, and one told the stun is on Q will get stunned at the exact moment he thinks he is safe: at three stacks.
audit.corrected: Devour re-described as a champion-target ability, grey health re-attributed to Thick Skin, and the Q stun gated on three stacks. Abyssal Dive corrected from 'escape + shield' to a 1000-1200 range dive that knocks up, at 21s at rank 1.

notes:
Devour was described three times as something Tahm Kench casts on himself or a minion. It targets a champion — damage on an enemy, a shield on an ally. Self-devour is not in the live kit. The grey health was credited to his passive in four places; it is Thick Skin (E), while An Acquired Taste is the damage passive and the Devour stack counter. Tongue Lash was called a stun with no mention that it only stuns at three stacks. Abyssal Dive was called 'his escape + shield' in the cooldown row and dosFull; it is a 1000-1200 range dive that knocks up.
